hints.title: Multi-Set Random Sampling Structure
hints.text: Supporting duplicate elements while guaranteeing equal probability random picks in constant time requires contiguous array indexing paired with inverted index groupings.

hints.title: Swap with Back for Constant Removal
hints.text: Store values in a contiguous array. Maintain a map from each value to the set of its indices in the array. To delete, swap the target value index with the last element of the array.

hints.title: Index Set Reassignment Blueprint
hints.text: On remove(val): pop an index from indices[val]. Let last_val = vals[-1]. If remove_idx does not equal last_idx, overwrite vals[remove_idx] = last_val, update indices[last_val] by removing last_idx and adding remove_idx. Pop vals.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
import random
from collections import defaultdict

class RandomizedCollection:
    def __init__(self):
        self.vals = []
        self.indices = defaultdict(set)

    def insert(self, val: int) -> bool:
        not_present = len(self.indices[val]) == 0
        self.indices[val].add(len(self.vals))
        self.vals.append(val)
        return not_present

    def remove(self, val: int) -> bool:
        if not self.indices[val]:
            return False
        remove_idx = self.indices[val].pop()
        last_val = self.vals[-1]
        last_idx = len(self.vals) - 1

        if remove_idx != last_idx:
            self.vals[remove_idx] = last_val
            self.indices[last_val].remove(last_idx)
            self.indices[last_val].add(remove_idx)

        self.vals.pop()
        return True

    def getRandom(self) -> int:
        return random.choice(self.vals)
```

complexity.notes: All operations execute in O(1) amortized time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Array deletion without swapping takes O(N) due to element shifting; hash sets without arrays cannot pick random items in uniform O(1).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Index sets maintain exact array positions to enable constant-time swaps.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Careful handling of edge cases where the removed item is already at the last position of the array.
